note: Stands in for what the GitHub store returns: entry id -> blob SHA. A version is file metadata, never document content — storing a hash of a document inside that document would be circular. See domain/TimeEntry.Persistence/Documents.fs. Two entries carry versions because a merge needs at least two sources that were each read at a known version (TE-R-070), and nothing created in the page has one until effects are performed (WI-0033, OQ-8).
